messages:
opsbot: :rotating_light: Pager: High latency spike observed in APAC region affecting economy tier routing (rate > 2.5x baseline). Alert: latency_p99 > 2.2s for 5m. [dashboard] https://console.redwood.io/d/latency/apac
ryan_oncall: I'm on it. Investigating smart-routing decisions and recent policy changes.
anya_sre: looking at tracing — requests hit economy lane nodes in ap-southeast and got queued. KV cache miss rate up ~30%.
maya_eng: rolling deploy of batching optimization finished ~10m ago, but only to eu/us. nothing touched in APAC config.
jordan_pm: any customer-visible errors? support, can you surface impacted tenants?
lin_support: quick scan: 3 enterprise customers seeing increased tail latency, plus ~120 PLG users in APAC. No 5xx spike. Customers notified via status page?
ryan_oncall: status.redwood.infra: updated "degraded performance in APAC economy tier". pinging SRE runbook.
anya_sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale down economy tier weight in APAC routing by 30% 2) enable latency-priority for premium routes 3) lift soft rate-limits for impacted enterprise tenants 4) enable KV prefix cache warmup for recent keys.
maya_eng: agree. adding: flip smart-routing flag to prefer regional low-latency nodes for sessions with latency sensitivity header.
ryan_oncall: executing step 1 now: applying policy patch.

Command:

```
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP_API" \
  https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/policies/steering -d '{"region":"apac","adjust":-0.3,"target":"economy"}'
```

ryan_oncall: PATCH accepted, new weights will converge over ~45s.
anya_sre: step 2 toggle:
```
PATCH /config/smart-routing
{"priority_overrides": {"tier":"premium","policy":"latency"}}
```
anya_sre: toggle applied.
lee_infra: increased quota for tenants corp-omega and corp-satellite by +20% for next 30m.
lin_support: notifying customers (CS already on emails).
jordan_pm: draft customer impact note: "We observed increased latency for economy-tier requests in APAC between 03:24-03:50 UTC; premium customers should be unaffected after mitigation. We're monitoring."
maya_eng: monitoring dashboards — p99 dropping from 2.2s -> 1.1s in APAC economy after policy change. KV miss rate improving.
ryan_oncall: good trend. leaving a short postmortem stub in incidents channel. tagging next oncall for full runbook: @anya_sre will take lead for RCA and follow-on fixes. handing off at 03:40 UTC.
anya_sre: taking lead. action items: collect routing decision logs, validate cache warming policy, consider autoscale thresholds for economy lane.
lee_infra: saving policy change IDs and audit log: policy-change-id: pc-2026-3901.
lin_support: closing customer notify loop. no further escalations.
jordan_pm: will prepare external status update + timeline.
ryan_oncall: thanks team. marking incident as mitigated in PagerDuty and setting reminder for RCA next biz day. :thumbsup:
